_finding: Owner, 23.11: a Telegram bot without a language model. Its guarantees are the fixed words: an unreadable check is never 'listed', the creator's symbol never reaches a reply, a restart never floods the alert channel, a backfilled case is not news, and the chat is paced.

mutations.name: an unanswered check reads as listed
mutations.expect: FAIL an API that does not answer is UNAVAILABLE, never listed

mutations.name: the look-alike line takes the creator's own symbol
mutations.expect: FAIL a creator's own text never reaches the reply, whatever field it hides in

mutations.name: the first pass posts what is already open
mutations.expect: FAIL the first pass marks what is there and posts nothing, so a restart never floods the channel

mutations.name: a backfilled case is posted as news
mutations.expect: FAIL then each new case once: a backfilled one is not news, a seen one is not repeated

mutations.name: the pacer lets a seventh check through
mutations.find: if (xs.length >= perMin) { seen.set(chat, xs); return false }
mutations.replace: if (xs.length > perMin) { seen.set(chat, xs); return false }
mutations.expect: FAIL six checks a minute per chat; the seventh waits

mutations.name: replies go out with a link preview
mutations.find: try { await tg('sendMessage', { chat_id: m.chat.id, text, disable_web_page_preview: true }) }
mutations.replace: try { await tg('sendMessage', { chat_id: m.chat.id, text }) }
mutations.expect: FAIL each message is answered in its own chat, as plain text with no link preview
